description: Mask a secret already posted (a key, a token, a password) everywhere the board keeps it. `find` is the shortest string identifying it ('sk_live_', or the whole value); `keep` leaves that many leading chars readable ('sk_live_******'). Everything from the match to the next WHITESPACE is starred, in every message and memory you see. Anyone may call it. Redact a leak the moment you notice it, never mind whose it was; dryRun reports first. NOT rotation: those characters already rode the stream, the webhooks and last night's backup, so tell the human to rotate at the source.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without writing

find.description: The secret, or the shortest prefix identifying it

keep.description: Leading characters left readable (0 masks all)

message.description: One message id; omitted sweeps all you can see

name: redact
title: Redact a secret
